chatV2_communityCommunityChatSyncingBody.en: {communicationUnavailableReason}LOOP has recorded your membership; the provider hasn't caught up yet. Retry later; you don't need to rejoin the community.
chatV2_communityCommunityChatSyncingBody.zh: {communicationUnavailableReason}LOOP 已经记录了你的成员身份，服务商侧还没跟上。稍后重试即可，不需要重新加入社区。

chatV2_communityEmptyReason.en: It may have been removed or isn't visible to this account.
chatV2_communityEmptyReason.zh: 它可能已被移除，或对当前账号不可见。

chatV2_communityReason.en: Enter from the community list or community page; this page won't guess which community's official group to open.
chatV2_communityReason.zh: 请从社区列表或社区主页进入，本页不会猜测要打开哪个社区的官方群。

chatV2_communityReason2.en: Capabilities haven't loaded yet; this page doesn't request any channel.
chatV2_communityReason2.zh: 尚未读取到能力清单，本页不请求任何频道。

chatV2_communityS.en: You appear as {alias} in this community

chatV2_directMessageCaption.en: Direct messages show minimal identity by default; asset and signature requests are labelled separately.
chatV2_directMessageCaption.zh: 私聊默认展示最少身份信息，资产与签名请求会单独标识。

chatV2_directMessageDmFriendshipRequired.en: Message request sent. The conversation appears here once they accept.
chatV2_directMessageDmFriendshipRequired.zh: 消息请求已经发出。对方接受之前，这里不会出现会话。

chatV2_directMessageDmFriendshipRequired.en: Direct messages need both of you to be friends, and the other person mustn't have turned off direct messages in Privacy Center. Send a message request first; the conversation opens once they accept. This doesn't mean the account exists.
chatV2_directMessageDmFriendshipRequired.zh: 私聊需要双方成为好友，并且对方没有在隐私中心关掉私聊。先发送一条消息请求，对方接受后这个会话才会打开。这个结果不代表对方账号一定存在。

chatV2_directMessageDmOperatorRequiredDe.en: This request was received and needs manual handling to finish. There's no retry here: resubmitting opens a second action. Contact support, then come back to this conversation.
chatV2_directMessageDmOperatorRequiredDe.zh: 这次请求已经收到，需要人工处理才能完成。这里不提供重试：重新提交会开出第二个操作。请联系支持后再回到这个会话。

chatV2_directMessageDmOperatorRequiredNo.en: This request is recorded. Sending it again won't be faster; it only adds another pending record.
chatV2_directMessageDmOperatorRequiredNo.zh: 这次请求已经记录，重复发起不会更快，只会多出一条待处理记录。

chatV2_directMessageEmptyMessage.en: This direct message isn't open yet

chatV2_directMessageEmptyReason.en: This conversation can't be opened right now.

chatV2_directMessageNotFound.en: They aren't discoverable, or this account doesn't exist. The message request wasn't sent.
chatV2_directMessageNotFound.zh: 对方没有开放被找到，或者这个账号不存在，消息请求没有送出。

chatV2_directMessageReason.en: Enter from Following, Message requests or a public profile; this page won't guess whose direct message to open.
chatV2_directMessageReason.zh: 请从关注列表、陌生人请求或公开资料进入，本页不会猜测要打开谁的私聊。

chatV2_forwardScreensBody.en: Selected messages are sent as new messages labelled with their source conversation. Deleted or empty messages are skipped.
chatV2_forwardScreensBody.zh: 选中的消息会作为新消息发出，并标注来自哪个会话。已删除或没有正文的消息会跳过。

chatV2_forwardScreensCaption.en: Forward up to {chatForwardSelectionLimit} messages at a time, only to conversations you've joined. Deleted or empty messages are skipped and counted.
chatV2_forwardScreensCaption.zh: 一次最多转发 {chatForwardSelectionLimit} 条，目标只能是你已加入的会话。已删除或没有正文的消息会被跳过并计数。

chatV2_forwardScreensCaption2.en: The merged preview only shows "{chatMergeAnonymousLabel}", time and text, with no nickname, LOOP ID or wallet address.
chatV2_forwardScreensCaption2.zh: 合并预览只输出「{chatMergeAnonymousLabel}」、时间与正文，不含昵称、LOOP ID 或钱包地址。

chatV2_forwardScreensChatForwardErrorRea.en: Couldn't load this conversation's messages and targets; nothing was forwarded.
chatV2_forwardScreensChatForwardErrorRea.zh: 没有读到这个会话的消息与可用目标，本页没有转发任何内容。

chatV2_forwardScreensChatForwardMissingS.en: Enter Forward from a conversation; this page won't guess which conversation to forward from.
chatV2_forwardScreensChatForwardMissingS.zh: 请从会话页进入转发，本页不会猜测要转发哪个会话的消息。

chatV2_forwardScreensChatForwardNoMessag.en: Only text messages synced to this device can be forwarded.
chatV2_forwardScreensChatForwardNoMessag.zh: 只有已同步到本机的文本消息可以被转发。

chatV2_forwardScreensChatForwardNoMessag.en: No messages to forward in this conversation
chatV2_forwardScreensChatForwardNoMessag.zh: 这个会话还没有可转发的消息

chatV2_forwardScreensChatForwardNoTarget.en: Forward targets must be conversations you've joined.
chatV2_forwardScreensChatForwardNoTarget.zh: 转发目标必须是你已加入的会话。

chatV2_forwardScreensChatForwardScreenSu.zh: {selectedCount} 条已选择 · 选择目标会话

chatV2_forwardScreensChatMergeEmptyMessa.en: Go back to Forward and pick up to {chatMergeSelectionLimit} messages to merge.
chatV2_forwardScreensChatMergeEmptyMessa.zh: 回到转发页选择要合并的消息，最多 {chatMergeSelectionLimit} 条。

chatV2_forwardScreensChatMergeTruncatedB.en: Merge up to {chatMergeSelectionLimit} messages at a time; the rest won't appear in the preview.
chatV2_forwardScreensChatMergeTruncatedB.zh: 一次最多合并 {chatMergeSelectionLimit} 条，多出的部分不会出现在预览里。

chatV2_forwardScreensLoopLabel2.zh: 发送到 · 最近 {chatForwardTargetPageSize} 个会话

chatV2_forwardScreensMessage.en: Select up to {chatForwardSelectionLimit} at a time

chatV2_forwardScreensMessage4.zh: 已转发 {sent} 条，跳过 {skipped} 条

chatV2_forwardScreensSubtitle.en: Deleted or empty; skipped when forwarding.
chatV2_forwardScreensSubtitle.zh: 已删除或没有正文，转发时会被跳过。

chatV2_forwardScreensText2.en: Wallet addresses, nicknames and internal IDs don't appear in the image, and the image isn't uploaded.
chatV2_forwardScreensText2.zh: 钱包地址、昵称与内部编号不会出现在长图里，长图也不会上传。

chatV2_forwardTargetSheetChatForwardOutc.en: {unavailable} deleted or not on this device; not forwarded
chatV2_forwardTargetSheetChatForwardOutc.zh: {unavailable} 条已删除或不在本机，未转发

chatV2_forwardTargetSheetContent.en: Last {chatForwardTargetPageSize} joined conversations · Forwarded messages show their source
chatV2_forwardTargetSheetContent.zh: 最近 {chatForwardTargetPageSize} 个已加入的会话 · 转发后会标注来源会话

chatV2_forwardTargetSheetForwardTargetSh.en: Couldn't load conversations to forward to; nothing was forwarded.
chatV2_forwardTargetSheetForwardTargetSh.zh: 没有读到可转发的会话，本次没有转发任何内容。

chatV2_groupScreensBody.en: You won't get messages from this group after leaving. The group creator can't leave.
chatV2_groupScreensBody.zh: 退出后你不会再收到这个群的消息。群创建者不能退出。

chatV2_groupScreensCaption.en: Members, notifications and Leave are ordered from low to high risk. Only confirmed info is shown here.
chatV2_groupScreensCaption.zh: 成员、通知与退出按风险从低到高排列。这里只显示已确认的信息。

chatV2_groupScreensErrorText.en: Group name must be 1–40 characters with no control characters
chatV2_groupScreensErrorText.zh: 群名称需要 1–40 个字符，且不能含控制字符

chatV2_groupScreensGroupInfoCapabilityUn.en: Capabilities haven't loaded yet; this page doesn't request any group resource.
chatV2_groupScreensGroupInfoCapabilityUn.zh: 尚未读取到能力清单，本页不请求任何群资源。

chatV2_groupScreensGroupInfoMissingCidDe.en: Enter from a group chat; this page won't guess which group's info to open.
chatV2_groupScreensGroupInfoMissingCidDe.zh: 请从群聊页进入，本页不会猜测要打开哪个群的信息。

chatV2_groupScreensGroupInfoResolveFaile.en: This group's info isn't confirmed yet, so you can't leave; no change was submitted.
chatV2_groupScreensGroupInfoResolveFaile.zh: 这个群的信息还没确认，暂时不能退出，也没有提交任何改动。

chatV2_groupScreensGroupInfoStateEmptyMe.en: This group wasn't found, or you're no longer a member. This doesn't mean leaving failed.
chatV2_groupScreensGroupInfoStateEmptyMe.zh: 找不到这个群，或者你已经不是成员了。这不代表退出失败。

chatV2_groupScreensGroupInfoStateEmptyTi.zh: 没有可退出的群成员关系

chatV2_groupScreensGroupInfoStateUnavail.en: The group membership service isn't available right now; no change was submitted.
chatV2_groupScreensGroupInfoStateUnavail.zh: 群成员关系服务暂时不可用，本页没有提交任何变更。

chatV2_groupScreensGroupScopeNoteText.en: Regular groups have no community token, no Mining Weight and no Community AI. Communities with tokens are under Community.
chatV2_groupScreensGroupScopeNoteText.zh: 普通群没有社区币、没有 Mining Weight，也没有 Community AI。带币社区在「社区」栏。

chatV2_groupScreensNotFound.en: The group doesn't exist or you're no longer in it.
chatV2_groupScreensNotFound.zh: 群不存在或你已不在群里。

chatV2_groupScreensPermissionDenied.en: Only the group owner can change the group name; nothing was changed.
chatV2_groupScreensPermissionDenied.zh: 只有群主可以修改群名称；这次没有改动。

chatV2_groupScreensReason.en: Enter from the conversation list or group info; this page won't guess which group to open.
chatV2_groupScreensReason.zh: 请从会话列表或群信息进入，本页不会猜测要打开哪个群。

chatV2_groupScreensUnavailable.en: Renaming isn't available right now; the group name wasn't changed.
chatV2_groupScreensUnavailable.zh: 改名暂时不可用，群名称没有改动。

chatV2_groupScreensValidationFailed.en: Group name must be 1–40 characters with no control characters.
chatV2_groupScreensValidationFailed.zh: 群名称需要 1–40 个字符，且不能含控制字符。

chatV2_mergeExportDismissed.en: Image created, but no share destination was chosen
chatV2_mergeExportDismissed.zh: 已生成长图，但没有选择分享去处

chatV2_mergeExportFailed.en: Couldn't create the image; nothing left this device
chatV2_mergeExportFailed.zh: 长图没有生成成功，没有任何内容离开这台设备

chatV2_mergeExportShared.en: Image created. Choose where to share it
chatV2_mergeExportShared.zh: 长图已生成，请在分享面板中选择去处

chatV2_mergeExportUnavailable.en: System sharing isn't available in this run; no image was created
chatV2_mergeExportUnavailable.zh: 本次运行没有装配系统分享，长图未生成

chatV2_messageSelectionBody.en: Everyone in the conversation will see "Message deleted". This can't be undone.
chatV2_messageSelectionBody.zh: 删除后会话里的每个人都会看到「消息已删除」，无法撤回。

chatV2_messageSelectionMessage.en: Select up to {loopMessageSelectionLimit} at a time

chatV2_messageSelectionMessage2.en: {unavailable} deleted or not on this device; left out of the image
chatV2_messageSelectionMessage2.zh: {unavailable} 条已删除或不在本机，没有放进长图

chatV2_messageSelectionShow3.en: {unavailable} no longer on this device; skipped

chatV2_messageSelectionTitle.en: {count, plural, =1{Delete this message?} other{Delete these {count} messages?}}

chatV2_modelsSwitch.en: Only members with anonymous mode on show as anonymous; discoverability doesn't affect this row.
chatV2_modelsSwitch.zh: 只有开启匿名模式的成员显示为匿名；是否可被发现不影响这一行。

chatV2_modelsSwitch10.en: The voice room is still being verified; this page won't start any voice connection until it passes.
chatV2_modelsSwitch10.zh: 语音房还在验证中，验证通过前这一页不会发起任何语音连接。

chatV2_modelsSwitch11.en: Couldn't load the online count, so no number is shown.
chatV2_modelsSwitch11.zh: 在线人数暂时读不到，因此不显示数字。

chatV2_modelsSwitch12.en: Listening isn't open in this room yet. Refresh, or ask the host to reopen it.
chatV2_modelsSwitch12.zh: 这个房间还没有开放收听。刷新一次，或让主持人重新开启。

chatV2_modelsSwitch13.en: This room hasn't confirmed listening is open, so you may not hear anything. Refresh, or ask the host to reopen it.
chatV2_modelsSwitch13.zh: 这个房间还没有确认开放收听，现在可能听不到。刷新一次，或让主持人重新开启。

chatV2_modelsSwitch14.en: This voice room isn't set up on the provider yet, so you can't join.
chatV2_modelsSwitch14.zh: 这个语音房还没有在服务商那边建好，现在进不去。

chatV2_modelsSwitch15.en: Your raised hand is recorded; the host may see it a bit later.
chatV2_modelsSwitch15.zh: 举手已经记下了，主持人可能要稍后才看到。

chatV2_modelsSwitch16.en: The provider hasn't confirmed this mute yet.
chatV2_modelsSwitch16.zh: 这次静音还没有在服务商那边确认。

chatV2_modelsSwitch17.en: Community AI isn't available yet, so this page is unavailable.
chatV2_modelsSwitch17.zh: Community AI 还没有开放，这一页暂时不可用。

chatV2_modelsSwitch2.en: This community doesn't have an official group channel yet.
chatV2_modelsSwitch2.zh: 该社区还没有官方群频道。

chatV2_modelsSwitch3.en: Your channel membership is syncing; you can join shortly.
chatV2_modelsSwitch3.zh: 你的频道成员身份正在同步，稍后即可进入。

chatV2_modelsSwitch4.en: The official group hit the provider's member limit, so you can't join right now. Your LOOP community membership isn't affected.
chatV2_modelsSwitch4.zh: 官方群已达到服务商的成员上限，暂时无法进入。你的 LOOP 社区成员资格不受影响。

chatV2_modelsSwitch5.en: The official group failed to create or sync and needs ops to fix it before you can join.
chatV2_modelsSwitch5.zh: 官方群创建或同步失败，需要运维介入后才能进入。

chatV2_modelsSwitch6.en: Join this community first to enter its official group.
chatV2_modelsSwitch6.zh: 需要先加入该社区，才能进入官方群。

chatV2_modelsSwitch7.en: Chat isn't available right now. Try again later.
chatV2_modelsSwitch7.zh: 聊天暂时不可用，稍后再试。

chatV2_modelsSwitch8.en: No live voice room in this community right now.
chatV2_modelsSwitch8.zh: 该社区当前没有进行中的语音房。

chatV2_modelsSwitch9.en: Chat isn't available in this environment yet.
chatV2_modelsSwitch9.zh: 聊天在当前环境还没有开放。

chatV2_searchChatSearchEmptyMessage.en: Try another keyword or a wider scope.
chatV2_searchChatSearchEmptyMessage.zh: 换一个关键词，或切换到更大的范围再试。

chatV2_searchChatSearchErrorReason.en: This search didn't finish; no results are shown.
chatV2_searchChatSearchErrorReason.zh: 这次检索没有完成，本页没有展示任何结果。

chatV2_searchChatSearchIdleMessage.en: Enter at least 2 characters. Results only come from conversations you've joined.
chatV2_searchChatSearchIdleMessage.zh: 至少输入 2 个字符。结果只来自你已加入的会话。

chatV2_searchChatSearchNotConnectedDetai.en: Chat search isn't available right now; this page made no request.
chatV2_searchChatSearchNotConnectedDetai.zh: 聊天搜索暂时不可用，这一页没有发起任何请求。

chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceLoopChatCompo.zh: 发消息 · 贴合约地址识别代币

chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceMessage.en: This conversation link isn't a channel address LOOP supports; no connection was made.
chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceMessage.zh: 这个会话链接不是 LOOP 支持的频道地址，本页没有发起任何连接。

chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceMessage3.en: Device offline. Chat authorization wasn't restored and no message was sent.
chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceMessage3.zh: 设备当前离线，没有恢复聊天授权，也没有发送任何消息。

chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceMessage4.en: Couldn't restore chat authorization; no message action was taken.
chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceMessage4.zh: 聊天授权没有恢复成功，本页没有发起任何消息操作。

chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceMessage5.en: Confirming this channel and your membership…
chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceMessage5.zh: 正在确认这个频道以及你的成员身份…

chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceMessage6.en: Device offline. Channel membership wasn't confirmed and no message was sent.
chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceMessage6.zh: 设备当前离线，没有确认这个频道的成员身份，也没有发送任何消息。

chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceNotConnected.en: Couldn't reach the chat service. Check your network and retry.
chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceNotConnected.zh: 没有连上聊天服务，请检查网络后重试。

chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceNotConnectedM.en: This conversation can't be opened right now. Try again later.
chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceNotConnectedM.zh: 这个会话暂时打不开，稍后再试。

chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceNotOpened.en: Couldn't open this channel's conversation. Try again later.
chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceNotOpened.zh: 没能打开这个频道的会话，请稍后重试。

chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceRefused.en: You're not a member of this group yet; LOOP didn't open any conversation.
chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceRefused.zh: 你还不是这个群的成员，LOOP 没有打开任何会话。

chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceSwitch.en: This channel hasn't synced to your account yet; LOOP didn't open any conversation.
chatV2_streamChannelSurfaceSwitch.zh: 这个频道还没有同步到你的账号，LOOP 没有打开任何会话。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensBody.en: Leaving exits this call and cancels your raised hand; to keep listening you'll need to rejoin.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensBody.zh: 离开后你会退出这次通话，举手也会一并取消；想继续收听需要重新加入。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensBody2.en: Ending disconnects everyone in the room right away; the room can't be entered again and the hand-raise queue is discarded. Hosts don't have Leave: the host decides whether the room continues. To step away from this page, use Back; the room collapses to the top and you can return anytime. The community can start a new one.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensBody2.zh: 结束后房间里的所有人都会立刻断开，这个房间不能再进入，举手队列也会作废。主持人没有「离开」：房间的存续由主持人决定。只是想暂时离开这一页，请用返回键，房间会收起在顶部，随时可以回来。社区可以再开一个新的。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensChooseVoiceRoomMe.en: The server sends the actions available for each row; only the ones you can actually use are listed.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensChooseVoiceRoomMe.zh: 这一行可以执行的操作由服务端逐行下发，这里只列出真正可用的。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensDetail.en: No voice connection is started here. Refresh, or ask the host to reopen it.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensDetail.zh: 这里不会发起语音连接。刷新一次，或让主持人重新开启。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensEmpty2.en: This community has no live voice room right now.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensEmpty2.zh: 这个社区现在没有进行中的语音房。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensEmptyMessage.en: No live voice room right now
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensEmptyMessage.zh: 当前没有进行中的语音房

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensInviteSpeaker.en: Target: {name}. Once invited, they become a speaker and can talk in this call.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensInviteSpeaker.zh: 目标：{name}。邀请后对方成为发言人，可以在这次通话里说话。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensLoading2.zh: 正在读取这个社区的语音房。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage10.en: LOOP has no speakers recorded for this room yet. The host isn't in this list.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage10.zh: LOOP 记录里这个房间还没有发言人。主持人不在这份名单里。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage11.en: LOOP has no listeners recorded for this room yet. The host isn't in this list.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage11.zh: LOOP 记录里这个房间还没有听众。主持人不在这份名单里。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage2.en: Listening isn't open in this room yet
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage2.zh: 这个房间还没有开放收听

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage4.en: Leaving stage isn't available right now

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage5.en: Room ended · The host ended this voice room
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage5.zh: 房间已结束 · 主持人已经结束这个语音房

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage7.en: Left voice room; voice cleanup wasn't confirmed
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage7.zh: 已离开语音房，语音连接的收尾没有确认

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage8.en: Mic is on, but the mute flag on the list couldn't be cleared: {communityFailureReason}
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage8.zh: 麦克风已打开，但名单上的静音标记没能撤回：{communityFailureReason}

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage9.en: Hand raised, waiting for the host to invite you
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMessage9.zh: 已举手，等待主持人邀请

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMute.en: Target: {name}. Mute is a LOOP-side intent; their device may still unmute itself. You can undo it on this row later.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensMute.zh: 目标：{name}。静音是 LOOP 侧的意图，对方的设备仍可能自行开麦；之后可以在这一行取消。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensRemoveSpeaker.en: Target: {name}. After removal they go back to listening and stay in the room.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensRemoveSpeaker.zh: 目标：{name}。移出后对方回到听众，仍然留在房间里。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensS2.en: Room ended; voice cleanup wasn't confirmed
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensS2.zh: 房间已结束，语音连接的收尾没有确认

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSubtitle.zh: 点这一行可以取消静音

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSubtitle2.zh: 主持人已在 LOOP 侧静音

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSubtitle4.en: Waiting for the host to invite

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSwitch.en: The voice room is recorded, but the call isn't set up yet. Tap Start voice room again to continue.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSwitch.zh: 语音房记下了，但通话还没有建好。再点一次「开启语音房」可以接着建。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSwitch10.en: Back collapses the room to the top; tap it to return anytime.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSwitch10.zh: 返回会把房间收起在顶部，随时点开回来。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSwitch11.en: Check the host, online count and recording notice before joining.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSwitch11.zh: 进入前确认主持人、在线人数与录音说明。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSwitch2.en: The voice room is set up but listening isn't open yet. Tap Start voice room again to retry.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSwitch2.zh: 语音房建好了，但还没有开放收听。再点一次「开启语音房」可以重试。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSwitch3.en: The voice room isn't ready, so no one can join yet. Tap Start voice room again to retry.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSwitch3.zh: 语音房还没有准备好，现在谁都进不去。再点一次「开启语音房」可以重试。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSwitch4.en: LOOP submitted this change; the provider hasn't confirmed it yet. Refresh later for the latest status.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSwitch4.zh: LOOP 已经提交这次变更，服务商还没有确认结果。请稍后刷新查看最新状态。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSwitch9.en: Couldn't load the voice room status this time; you can retry below.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensSwitch9.zh: 这次没有读到语音房的状态，下面可以重试。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensText.en: Leaving exits this call and cancels your raised hand.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensText.zh: 离开后你会退出这次通话，举手也会一并取消。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensUnmute.en: Target: {name}. This only withdraws the LOOP-side mute intent and won't turn on their mic; only their device can do that.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensUnmute.zh: 目标：{name}。只撤回 LOOP 侧的静音意图，不会替对方打开麦克风——开麦只能由对方的设备完成。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensUnmuteSelf.en: This is your own speaker row. It only clears the LOOP-side mute flag and won't turn on your mic; unmute yourself in the call.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensUnmuteSelf.zh: 这是你自己的发言人行。只撤回 LOOP 侧的静音标记，不会打开麦克风——请在通话里自己开麦。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceRoomTopbarLi.zh: 进行中 · 发言 {speaking} · 听众 {listening}

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomCapabili.en: This device couldn't load the voice room's availability. Check your network and retry.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomCapabili.zh: 这台设备没能读到语音房的开放状态，请检查网络后重试。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomCapabili.en: Couldn't load the voice room's availability yet. Try again later.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomCapabili.zh: 这次还没有读到语音房的开放状态，请稍后再试。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomEndedMes.en: The host ended this voice room.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomEndedMes.zh: 主持人已经结束这个语音房。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomHostNoLe.en: Couldn't load End room this time. Try again later. Back collapses the room to the top.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomHostNoLe.zh: 「结束房间」这次读不到，请稍后再试。返回会把房间收起在顶部。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomHostNoLe.en: Can't end the room right now

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomInfoLabe.en: Room info, one item unconfirmed by the provider
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomInfoLabe.zh: 房间说明，有一项服务商未确认

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomInviteEm.en: Raised hands are listed here in order.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomInviteEm.zh: 有人举手后会按顺序列在这里。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomMediaUna.en: This voice room can't be opened right now; no connection was made.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomMediaUna.zh: 这个语音房暂时打不开，没有发起任何连接。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomMissingI.en: Enter from a community page or its official group; this page won't guess which community's voice room to open.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomMissingI.zh: 请从社区主页或社区官方群进入，本页不会猜测要打开哪个社区的语音房。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomNotJoina.en: The provider hasn't confirmed this room is ready, so joining would be refused. Refresh and try again later.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomNotJoina.zh: 服务商还没有确认这个房间已经就绪，加入会被拒绝。请稍后刷新再试。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomNotJoina.en: This room can't be joined yet

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomQueueEmp.en: No one is waiting. Raised hands are listed here in order.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomQueueEmp.zh: 没有成员在排队。有人举手后会按顺序列在这里。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomQueueSel.en: Only the host can see the full queue. Your position shows here after you raise your hand.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomQueueSel.zh: 完整的举手队列只有主持人能看到。举手之后，这里会显示你的位置。
第 {sequence} 位 · 等待邀请

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomSpeakerH.zh: 主持人 · 麦克风已开

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomStepDown.en: Only the host can change speakers. To leave the stage, ask the host or leave the room.
chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomStepDown.zh: 后端只允许主持人调整发言人。要退出发言，请联系主持人，或离开房间。

chatV2_voiceRoomScreensVoiceroomStepDown.en: Leaving stage yourself isn't available right now

chatV2_voiceRoomShareLine.en: Join the "{communityName}" voice room on LOOP: {roomTitle}

chatV2_voiceRoomStageBuild3.en: The room is visible to community members right away and anyone can listen in. As host, you or other admins invite speakers, mute all and end the room; the mic is off by default.
chatV2_voiceRoomStageBuild3.zh: 房间会立刻对社区成员可见，任何成员都能进来收听。你是主持人，邀请发言、全体静音和结束房间都由你或其他管理员操作；麦克风默认关闭。

chatV2_voiceRoomStageHintText.en: Leave blank to show "Community name voice room"
chatV2_voiceRoomStageHintText.zh: 留空时显示「社区名 语音房」

chatV2_voiceRoomStageLabel.en: {count, plural, =1{1 more listener} other{{count} more listeners}}{onTap}

chatV2_voiceRoomStageVoiceroomListenersP.zh: 没有权限查看听众名单

chatV2_voiceRoomStageVoiceroomSpeakersPe.zh: 没有权限查看发言人名单

chatV2_voiceRoomStageVoiceroomSpeakersUn.zh: 发言人名单当前不可用

chatV2_voiceRoomStageVoiceroomStartPendi.en: The last go-live didn't finish. Going live again finishes it and keeps the title you entered.
chatV2_voiceRoomStageVoiceroomStartPendi.zh: 上一次开播还没有完成，再开播会接着完成它，标题沿用当时填写的内容。
